text: Türkiye Wealth Fund, Turkey's sovereign wealth fund, owns 49.12% of Turkish Airlines; the other Group A shares are publicly held. The single Group C share, held by the Ministry of Treasury and Finance's Privatization Administration, carries privileged voting rights over nominations to the board of directors.
